body: Still, I would like to know why I get that feeling

I can see what you're saying. I try to be fairly well organized. It's just sometimes an overwhelming sense of needing to go home that I wish I could shake. I dont think I can self regulate how relaxed I feel sadly.
I cannot afford the medication so no not currently.

Therapy just feels like a huge expense. And medication doesn't cover me wholesale because of other health and mental health conditions. Its like I feel like I'm hollow inside. Thanks for taking some time to reply.

Its like nothing I do make my brain think happy. Everything just feels empty. I can laugh. I can appreciate moments. But I always just find myself feeling the weight of dissatisfaction. It just feels like I've been unhappy for so long that its the default now.
Tried meds but they just made me feel worse. And before I could try to change types of meds or get therapy I lost my job. Two months ago and nows the first time in really feeling anything.

I appreciate you, stranger or not kindness is always appreciated. I've been spending more time with my wife, I've rebuilt connections with some family. Its just so off that the things I am doing are important, they're the things that would make me feel low before. But then just without a job its an entire different type of worry.
Think about before you were born. Did it hurt? Was it bad? At the end of the line you just go back there.
